limitations: WASI runs use a cooperative single-threaded runtime; these executions do not establish multi-threaded WASM mutex semantics.
Sub-second runtimes can finish between memory samples; zero sampled runtime RSS does not mean zero allocation.
Ordinary CS/SSI policy factories and other Geometry/Kernel paths are outside this focused closure.
